# Official tariff regression evidence

Retrieved on 15 September 2026 from:
https://www.trade-tariff.service.gov.uk/uk/api/commodities/7323930010?as_of=2026-09-15&filter%5Bgeographical_area_id%5D=CN

The adjacent JSON file retains the full response, without removing alternative
measures or conditions. The test uses an explicit test timestamp and synthetic
operator evidence; neither represents a submitted declaration or approval.

This snapshot contains seven definitive anti-dumping measures under legal act
N1904500. Measure 20042340, additional code A999, has an unconditional structured
42.3% component. Six exporter alternatives carry conditions, including D008
(invoice with a signed declaration). The regression verifies that the existing
unconditional adapter accepts the reviewed general rate and rejects the
conditional exporter rate. It does not certify eligibility, CDS rounding or
enable automatic declared-tax population.
